items.title: Thor from the popular game gets a 55-kilogram statue
items.summary: The manufacturer has also prepared a special edition with additional heads, hands and new display options.
items.content:
The manufacturer has also prepared a special edition with additional heads, hands and new display options.

Photo: Printscreen Disclaimer: The translations are mostly done through AI translator and might not be 100% accurate. M MV 18.10.2026. 18:17h Prime 1 Studio has announced a huge collectible statue of Thor, one of the main characters in the game "God of War Ragnarok." The price of this edition is as much as $ 1.599, and delivery is planned for the period from late 2026 to early 2027. The statue will be produced in a very limited number of copies.

Thor is one of the main antagonists of the game "God of War Ragnarok", which was released in November 2022 as the second part of the Norse saga by Santa Monica Studios.

The game also moved away from traditional depictions of characters from Norse mythology. One of the most striking examples is Thor, whose significantly larger build became one of his main visual features.

Prime 1 Studio's new collectible figure faithfully captures this look in a 1:3 scale. It measures approximately 105 centimeters tall, 83 centimeters wide, and weighs approximately 55 kilograms. The manufacturer plans to ship each figure in three separate boxes.

According to the current plan, deliveries will take place from November 2026 to February 2027. The company warns that the final dimensions of the statue may deviate by up to 10 percent, while the weight during production can vary by as much as 10 kilograms.

The imposing dimensions are partly the result of a detailed base inspired by Thor's appearance in the game. The frozen scene includes the ravens Hugin and Munin, as well as a large stone sculpture of Odin. Thor himself wears multi-layered leather armor, is tattooed and scarred, and his cloth cloak is removable.

His famous hammer Mjolnir is equipped with LED lighting, but the company has not yet decided whether it will be powered by batteries, via a USB port, or in some other way.

For collectors who want a richer edition, Prime 1 Studio is also preparing a Deluxe Bonus version priced at $1.999, which offers significantly more display options.

This package includes two interchangeable heads, three interchangeable left hands, a head stand, additional LED light effects, and a separate model of Thor's hammer Mjolnir. One possible pose shows Thor summoning his weapon, which increases the statue's overall height to approximately 118 centimeters. The Deluxe Edition weighs approximately 57 kilograms and will be produced in 299 units.

Thor will also receive a matching collectible figure of Kratos, his counterpart from the series, as part of the Prime 1 Studio Real Elite Masterline collection. The statue of the main character of the game "God of War Ragnarok" is also made in 1:3 scale and is priced at $ 1.599.

The Kratos statue stands approximately 95 centimeters tall and weighs approximately 51,5 kilograms. Its production is limited to just 100 pieces, with deliveries expected between April and July 2027.

The standard Thor edition will also be limited to just 100 copies, and interested buyers are currently being put on a waiting list. The Deluxe Bonus Edition, with a total of 299 copies, is still available for a limited number of pre-orders. This gives collectors a better chance of securing their own copy, provided they are willing to pay an additional $400.

items.title: Demon's Souls runs on PC at 60 FPS, while God of War Ragnarok still blinds players - PlayStation games tested on KyTyPS5 emulator

PlayStation 5 emulation is developing rapidly. Over the past months, players have gone from simply launching the Demon's Souls remake by Bluepoint Games to playing it at a high frame rate.

Recently, Geralt Benchmarks shared the results of a test of the Demon's Souls remake on an emulator: he managed to get an average of 60+ FPS, and with frame generation activated, 120 FPS can be achieved. The game was launched on a PC with an MD Ryzen 7 9800X3D processor and a GeForce RTX 5070 graphics card:

This is a build of the KytyPS5 emulator by chenxiao07, version v20261017. DLSS frame generation can be used, but upscaling is not yet available. The maximum resolution at the moment is 1440p. Stutters still occur quite often, and this version is far from perfect, but the emulator is improving very quickly. Image source: Sony Interactive Entertainment God of War Ragnarok has already been released on PC, but some tech enthusiasts are trying to run this game on an emulator as well. Recently, Video Game Esoterica drew attention to one such test: the game runs at 10 – 25 FPS, but many graphical bugs occur in gameplay — bright flashes appear.

items.title: 'Base Game Sold Separately' Again... Wave of Collector's Editions Without Games Continues
items.summary: ©SIE, Santa Monica StudiosAn announcement regarding the sale of the Collector's Edition for the new God of War title, 'God of War Laufey', has sparked controversy among gamers afte...
items.content:
Editions excluding base game emerge for God of War Laufey, GTA6, and more

Korean (한국어) KO Add us on ©SIE, Santa Monica Studios An announcement regarding the sale of the Collector's Edition for the new God of War title, 'God of War Laufey', has sparked controversy among gamers after including a statement that the game is not included.

On the 14th, publisher Sony and developer Santa Monica Studio posted an announcement on their official blog stating that sales for the God of War Laufey Collector's Edition would begin. The price is £129.99, which converts to approximately 230,000 won. Limited to one per person, the edition includes a statue of the protagonist Faye, a 51-card Oracle Deck, and a mini artbook.

The main point of controversy was the bold statement displayed at the top of the announcement and in the image, reading "God of War Laufey game sold separately." As Collector's Editions have traditionally included the main game, reactions expressing disappointment were widespread under the announcement posted on X.

Sony is not the first to make such a move. Rockstar Games previously unveiled the Vice City Edition, a Collector's Edition for GTA6, which also did not include the base game. With a growing number of Collector's Editions excluding the game itself, attention is focused on where this industry trend is headed.

items.title: God of War Laufey's $150 Collector Box Includes a Light-Up Faye Statue but no game
items.summary: God of War Laufey is the next big game to get a collector box without the game itself.
items.content:
Following in the footsteps of GTA 6, God of War Laufey is the next big game to get a collector box without the game itself.

Sony has revealed the collector box for God of War Laufey, which costs $150 and includes a nice statue of Faye. Unfortunately it does not include a steelbook with a disc copy of the game, or any copy of the game, physically or digitally. Preorders open today at 10am PT through PlayStation Direct, and stock is limited, Sony warned. You can view a full breakdown of the box's items below.

Predictably, a lot of people are drawing comparisons to the game-less GTA 6 collector's box . However, some may be a bit more accepting of the value God of War is offering here. GTA 6's box includes a bunch of Vice City-themed merch, such as a pair of sunglasses, a hat, and a figure of a cartoon gator named Macca. It also costs a whopping $400, which is tough to swallow.

Many were critical of the fact that GTA 6's box didn't include a statue of Jason and Lucia , in addition to feeling like the box could've been cheaper if it didn't include certain items. So, God of War Laufey may not be as egregious to some fans given it is a smaller box with a statue of the protagonist. Still, it does feel a bit lacking compared to previous God of War collector's editions.

God of War Ragnarok's collector's edition included Thor's hammer, a steelbook (no game disc, though), DLC, a code for PS4 and PS5 copies of the game, and a handful of other trinkets. God of War 2018's collector's edition included a statue of Kratos and Atreus, a steelbook with a disc, a physical map, a litograph, and two small figures of Brok and Sindri, in addition to a bunch of digital content.

While this is likely supposed to be an add-on for people who are already planning on buying the game, it's disappointing that God of War Laufey's box doesn't at least include a complimentary upgrade to the game's digital deluxe edition, which includes special armor and weapons in the full game.

God of War Laufey – Collector Box will be available in "highly limited quantities" exclusively direct from PlayStation on February 16, 2027 for a recommended retail price of $149.99 USD/ €149.99/ £129.99. Preorders begin today , October 13, 2026 at 10am local time.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

items.title: God of War Laufey Collector’s Box Is Up For Pre-Order, But It Has No Game
items.summary: PlayStation has opened the floodgates for God of War Laufey Collector's Box pre-orders today, but it doesn't include a copy of the game.
items.content:
Add us on Google PlayStation has opened the floodgates for God of War Laufey pre-orders today, including the limited Collector’s Box, but it doesn’t include a copy of the game.

It appears Collector’s Editions of games continue to leave out the most important part of the package . God of War Laufey is beelining for its release, and today, PlayStation announced that the next chapter in the Norse GoW saga is up for pre-order. This includes a limited edition Collector’s Box, which, like all other Collector’s Edition releases, contains physical goods based on the game’s universe that you can tangibly hold or decorate your house with. Although all of the added bells and whistles add to the purchase, in recent years, Collector’s Edition releases have started leaving out the most important part of the package: a copy of the game itself .

God of War: Ragnarok also had a Collector’s Edition (and a further upgraded Jotnar Edition) option on release, which contained numerous goods including a replica of Thor’s Hammer, Mjolnir. Back then, the two collector editions of the game launched with a code-in-box instead of a physical disc, and fans were not happy. Fans blasted the decision on forums like Reddit , saying the inclusion of a steelbook case was misleading, and it’s foolish to put an empty case on a shelf. With God of War Laufey ‘s Collector Box, they did not include a physical disc or a game code (or a steelbook), meaning this purchase does not have a copy of the game with it.

Recently, Rockstar Games also dropped a Collector Box for GTA VI called The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, retailing for $399.99. In bold print on the site , Rockstar states, “ Note: Grand Theft Auto VI game sold separately ,” meaning this big purchase is steeped in GTA VI merch that you might see in the game, without the game. God of War Laufey is following GTA VI rather than its predecessor, and dropping the game code from the box; no disc will be included with the purchase either.

God of War Laufey’s Collector Box includes a nifty light-up statue depicting Faye, a 51-card Oracle deck, and a mini-artbook. The whole package will run fans £129.99, as it is appearing on the UK site, and the Collector Box drops on the same day as the game, on February 16, 2027. Fans interested can pre-order straight from the PlayStation website .

items.title: God Of War Laufey Collector’s Edition Doesn’t Include The Game, This Time On Purpose
items.summary: After Ragnarok's special edition accidentally shipped without download codes, Sony seems to have taken inspiration
items.content:
I refuse to allow this to become normal. No matter how many times it happens, it’s completely deranged, and we should keep calling it out. God of War Laufey ‘s so-called Collector Box has been revealed (thanks PushSquare ), containing a light-up statue, a 51-card deck and an art book, and…no copy of the game. Looking likely to cost around $130 (the U.S. version is yet to be announced, but the UK’s version is £130 ), you’ll still have to spend another $70 on top if you want to play the game the box is allegedly about.

First popping up on the Spanish PlayStation Store, the Caja de Coleccionista de God of War Laufey seemed to have leaked early, before other nations starting revealing the same, with the U.S. still to go. The box contains a resin statue of Faye fighting enemies with her long, pointy sword, complete with purple ribbon, accompanied by lit blue cubes for maximum garishness. There’s also a deck of Oracle cards, 51 in total, each with a unique illustration based on Faye’s journey, and apparently capable of Everywhen magic. And last of all there’s the requisite “mini artbook,” because for over $100 you cannot expect a full-size one. And that’s it. That’s a very expensive statuette, deck of cards, and pamphlet, and only more ridiculous when you consider you haven’t actually bought a copy of the game in the process.

Of course, God of War Laufey ‘s deal looks positively sensible when compared to Rockstar’s reveal of a $400 GTA 6 collector’s edition that also doesn’t come with the game. But the practice remains absolutely ludicrous given it’s the difference of putting a piece of paper with a code printed onto it. Given the items in the box can’t cost much more to produce than about $60 at a push, it’s pretty grim that it’s not in there by default, even putting aside the inherent weirdness of it. And unlike GTA 6 , Laufey is getting a physical release.

Making this even more strange is the debacle that occurred during the last God of War ‘s release. 2023’s Ragnarok had two different (far better) special editions, the Collector’s and the Jötnar Edition, both of which were supposed to come with a download code for the full game and—inexplicably— a steelbook display case that didn’t contain a disc . This then got worse when people discovered the download code hadn’t been included . This was at least an error that Sony worked to resolve, but three years later the absence is now entirely deliberate.

As for why this ever happens, one possible reason is cost-saving. If you are selling the game on multiple consoles, you need to produce multiple versions of the collector’s edition, and that means different SKUs, different box designs, and so on. Except, Laufey is a PS5 exclusive, so this doesn’t apply at all. It simply seems to be an exercise in finding out what can be gotten away with while still making money. At least the box doesn’t contain a disc case to not put a disc in this time, I guess.

items.title: God Of War Ragnarok Is Finally Cheap Enough To Make Me Say “Boy, Buy It”
God of War TV Series: The Next Blockbuster Video Game Adaptation, Explained
items.summary: Prime Video is adapting the acclaimed video game franchise God of War for television, with Sons of Anarchy
items.content:
There's a lot going on behind the scenes in this one.

Back in the day, video game adaptations were treated as disposable garbage not worth taking seriously, but that's changed in a big way lately thanks to the massive success of The Last of Us on HBO, Fallout on Prime Video, and Arcane on Netflix. It turns out video games are as good a source for stories as any other, even for prestige projects. And that's why Amazon and Sony have a live-action adaptation of the ultraviolent fantasy franchise God of War on the way for Prime Video.

God of War is one of the flagship video game brands for Sony, with the original game releasing back in 2005 for the PlayStation 2 and spawning more than a half-dozen sequels since then. The most recent title in the series, 2022's God of War Ragnarok , was Sony's biggest game launch ever , and God of War Laufey — which features a new female protagonist — is coming out in early 2027 and one of the year's most anticipated releases. So despite its age, this franchise is currently hitting its stride, making it the perfect time to adapt it into a big-budget TV series. Let's talk about it.

We're still pretty early on this project, but it's already undergone a surprising amount of upheaval. We'll start by talking about that .

With filming apparently starting over completely with new star Dave Bautista, we should expect a 2028 release at the earliest for God of War Season 1. The good news, however, is that the studio is planning to shoot Seasons 1 and 2 back to back, so there probably won't be a multi-year gap between them.

When the series was first revealed, TV veteran Ryan Hurst (who played Opie in Sons of Anarchy and Mentor in The Odyssey ) was announced as Kratos, the brawling hero of the franchise, which led to a weird backlash from loud and obnoxious gamers. I call it "weird" just because these folks didn't seem to have any beef at all with Hurst — they didn't seem to even know who he was, and they were angry that somebody they didn't know was going to play their beloved angry video game dad. After a few weeks of whining, the nerds got what they demanded, and Hurst has been replaced by Dave Bautista. The story goes that Hurst was injured several months into production, and that the injury would require a very long recovery time, and so they recast Kratos so they wouldn't have to delay production very long.

But it's rather unusual, under any circumstance, for a role like this to be recast with someone with a much higher profile. And it's tough to see an actor who actually has to work for a living, like Hurst, lose what would have been his biggest role ever to a big celebrity who will probably be paid a lot more. It's possible, though, that this drama isn't only about who's playing Kratos. Deadline reports that Sony won't be using any of the material that was shot when Hurst was playing Kratos, with production essentially starting over whenever filming begins with Bautista. The God of War show might actually have undergone a full creative reset, with the recasting just being one part of it.

The God of War series tells the story of Kratos, an ancient Spartan warrior who is manipulated by Ares into murdering his family in one of those classic Greek tragedies. Athena, seeing the wrong that was done to him, helps Kratos defeat Ares and claim his godhood for himself. The early games in the series told similar tales — some god tries to mess with Kratos, and Kratos goes on an extremely bloody quest for retribution. And Kratos is a real "I'm going to tear you apart with my bare hands" kind of guy, so these games are very violent and gory.

But Kratos' battle with the Greek pantheon will only be backstory for Amazon's TV adaptation, because the God of War show will be adapting the story of the franchise's soft reboot God of War , released in 2018, and its 2022 sequel God of War: Ragnarok . In the rebooted series, Kratos has left the world of Greek mythology behind and lives in Midgard with his son, Atreus. In this story, Kratos' wife Faye has died, and he and Atreus must travel to Jotunheim to spread her ashes from the highest peak. But it turns out that Faye was the key to preventing Ragnarok, and it doesn't take long before Kratos runs afoul of some major Norse deities — most notably Freya.

The essence of this story, though, is centered on a father and son's perilous journey through an increasingly hostile land — it's like The Last of Us: Fantasy Edition in that regard, both in terms of subject matter and how much people love the story. So it makes sense for a big-budget TV adaptation. The series will tell the story a bit differently than the games did, though, since four of the five characters who have been cast in the show thus far (Odin, Thor, Heimdall, and Sif) had no meaningful presence in the story until Ragnarok .

Hurst will be joined by Teresa Palmer, who is playing Thor's wife Sif, and Max Parker as Heimdall , who's a villain in this story. About a week after those folks were announced, Sony revealed that Mandy Patinkin ( Homeland ) will play Odin, and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson ( Severance ) will play his son Thor — with Odin being the story's main baddie. Additionally, Alastair Duncan will play Odin's former advisor Mimir, Jeff Gulka will play the dwarven blacksmith Sindri, and Danny Woodburn will play the dwarven weapons dealer Brok.

The villainous Baldur, who will serve as the main series antagonist for at least the first season, will be played by Ed Skrein. We've also got Sonya Walger (Penny from Lost ), who will play Odin's estranged wife Freya . Freya is a recurring role, at least for now. In the games, Freya had a small part in the 2018 reboot before taking on a much larger role in Ragnarok , so you can expect Walger's role to likewise increase over time.

The showrunner on God of War is TV legend Ronald D. Moore, who co-created the 2003 Battlestar Galactica reboot, Outlander, and For All Mankind. That track record is tough to argue with.

If you want to know more about what this franchise is all about, or just play through the backstory of the series, you can peruse past games in the series on Amazon below.

items.title: God of War Laufey Releases Feb. 16, 2027; Next Kratos-Led Game Coming After It
items.summary: God of War Laufey releases February 16, 2027, as a new Kratos-led game is coming after it and ties to its story.
items.content:
Revealed two months ago , God of War Laufey is the latest game in the franchise, though one with a new protagonist. If you’re excited to play another entry in the series, you’ll be glad to know we don’t have to wait long to experience it.

Sony has announced that God of War Laufey will be released on PS5 on February 16, 2027!

Not only did we get that info today, but confirmation of the next game after it too.

At San Diego Comic Con (via IGN ), Cory Barlog, studio head of creative at Santa Monica Studio, announced that the next Kratos-led God of War game is coming after Laufey, and connects directly to her story.

No further details were shared, so we don’t know the release date/window, which pantheon the game will be set at, etc. That said, given we saw Kratos make an appearance in God of War Laufey’s reveal gameplay trailer, this is hardly surprising.

For those not caught up to the latest God of War game on the way, Sony explains Laufey’s storyline as:

“Death was supposed to be the end, but for Laufey (Faye), warrior and wife to Kratos, a new adventure is just beginning. Awakening unexpectedly in a strange land after her death, Faye discovers the plans she put in place to protect Kratos and Atreus in her absence are now at risk.

To save the ones she loves, Faye must fight through the afterlife of the gods – the Everywhen – where ruthless gods from across mythology vie for power in a land overflowing with dangerous magic.

Harness Faye’s speed, control and relentlessness to overwhelm even the fiercest of foes with decisive, deadly precision.”

Laufey isn’t really shown in God of War (2018), but she is a “Guardian of the Jötnar, rebel leader against the oppressive Aesir gods, and lone protector of the Wildwoods – Laufey is a warrior whose battle prowess was legendary even among the Giants.”

Expect Laufey to expand the God of War universe, and give the character a proper story since all we saw was her dead at the start of Kratos’ Norse journey.

With God of War Laufey releasing early next year, a God of War Greek mythology remake , and confirmation of a new Kratos-led God of War title coming after Laufey, franchise fans be eating good!

That said, given Laufey is releasing next year, don’t expect a disc-based version of Kratos’ upcoming adventure, since Sony is ceasing physical disc versions of new games at the start of January 2028 . Unless Santa Monica Studio releases two God of War games in a year, which we’re willing to bet money on that it won’t happen.

items.title: ‘God of War’ Officially Brings Thor Back With a Massive New Release
items.summary: God of War Ragnarök’s Thor returns as a massive 1/3-scale Prime 1 Studio statue costing up to $2k and expected to ship by early 2027.
items.content:
Thor staring down menacingly at Heimdall in God of War: Ragnarok Image via PlayStation Studios By Adam Blevins Published Jul 20, 2026, 4:58 PM EDT Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios , House of the Dragon , and Planet of the Apes . He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday , The Penguin , Star Wars: Skeleton Crew , and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news. He has completed a set visit for The Chosen and even has several months of experience writing Gaming Features at ScreenRant . You can find him on X , LinkedIn , and Muckrack . Sign in to your Collider account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google Discover Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap 2026 has been a huge year for God of War fans, even though it's fast approaching four years since the launch of God of War: Ragnarök . All the way back in February, Santa Monica announced that it was working on a full remake of the original God of War trilogy, which will give fans a chance to relive Kratos’ conquest of the Greek pantheon. Just last month, at one of PlayStation’s most anticipated State of Play events in history, Santa Monica closed out the showcase by unveiling 20 minutes of interrupted gameplay footage from the first God of War spin-off game, God of War Laufey , which will be centered around Kratos’ late wife. The game still does not have an official release date, but it’s likely to launch sometime in 2027 .

One of the best characters to come out of the God of War Norse trilogy was Thor , the God of Thunder voiced by Ryan Hurst . Hurst was attached to play Kratos in Prime Video ’s live-action God of War series, but last week it was announced that he was being recast after suffering a torn pec sustained during a stunt. Hurst brought a much different take on the character than fans had seen from Chris Hemsworth ’s portrayal in the MCU , playing a much more complicated figure more accurate to Norse mythology. It was even announced over the weekend that Thor from God of War: Ragnarök is getting a brand-new figure courtesy of Prime1Studio , which is now available for pre-order for $1,599. The new figure is expected to ship between November 2026 and February 2027, and it will be 1/3 scale.

You believe in the cause — in the idea that freedom is worth fighting for even when the odds are impossible and the empire is vast.

You understand, in the deepest part of yourself, that the journey matters as much as the destination — and that the world's beauty is worth protecting even at great cost.

You believe that love, loyalty, and doing what's right are not naive sentiments — they are the most powerful forces in any world, magical or otherwise.

You see the world clearly — its power structures, its hypocrisies, its brutal arithmetic — and you are not paralysed by that clarity. You use it.

You believe the future is worth building — that curiosity, cooperation, and the expansion of understanding are not just ideals but the most practical path forward for any civilisation.

God of War Laufey takes place in Everywhen , which is an afterlife of the gods. Laufey is even seen battling Begtse, the Mongolian God of War, who is working with Sekhmet, the Egyptian God of War. items.summary: An NVIDIA Driver Crash/Soft Lock that prevents the game from loading is under investigation. In the meantime, we've implemented a work around for the cause of the crash to change how shader compilation works. This change may cause some micr
items.content:
An NVIDIA Driver Crash/Soft Lock that prevents the game from loading is under investigation. In the meantime, we've implemented a work around for the cause of the crash to change how shader compilation works. This change may cause some micro-stuttering during initial load, but will hopefully avoid the driver crash that prevents game from starting.

Please verify files after patching.

items.title: Patch 9 - 20th Anniversary Update
items.summary: As a gift to everyone who owns God of War Ragnarök, the Dark Odyssey collection is now available in-game at no additional cost! Inspired by the working name of God of War (2005) and the skin that originally appeared in God of War II as a re
items.content:
As a gift to everyone who owns God of War Ragnarök, the Dark Odyssey collection is now available in-game at no additional cost! Inspired by the working name of God of War (2005) and the skin that originally appeared in God of War II as a reward for beating the game on God Mode difficulty, we have brought back the black and gold theme for the anniversary.

Dark Odyssey Collection

Dark Odyssey Armor & Appearance for Kratos
  • Dark Odyssey Kratos Appearance
  • Dark Odyssey Armor Set for Kratos (Dark Odyssey Breastplate, Dark Odyssey Bracers, Dark Odyssey Belt)
Dark Odyssey Companion Armor
  • Dark Odyssey Vestment for Atreus
  • Dark Odyssey Witch Frock for Freya
Dark Odyssey Weapon Appearances & Attachments*
  • Dark Odyssey Leviathan Axe & Dark Odyssey Knob
  • Dark Odyssey Blades of Chaos & Dark Odyssey Handles
  • Dark Odyssey Draupnir Spear & Dark Odyssey Hind
Dark Odyssey Shield Appearances & Rönd
  • Dark Odyssey Guardian Shield
  • Dark Odyssey Dauntless Shield
  • Dark Odyssey Stone Wall Shield
  • Dark Odyssey Shatter Start Shield
  • Dark Odyssey Onslaught Shield
  • Dark Odyssey Spartan Aspis Shield
  • Dark Odyssey Rönd
*Please note, the weapon appearances are made for the fully upgraded version of each weapon and will only be available for use upon reaching that upgrade.

Edit Appearance for Weapon & Shield Attachments

With the addition of the new Dark Odyssey weapon attachments and shield rönd in the patch, we have added the ability to use the ‘Edit Appearance’ feature on those components of Kratos’ arsenal. You’ll be able to pick whatever visual suits your look with the functionality you want for your build!
